Question:
Frieda the frog begins a sequence of hops on a \(3 \times 3\) grid of squares, moving one square on each hop and choosing at random the direction of each hop—up, down, left, or right. She does not hop diagonally. When the direction of a hop would take Frieda off the grid, she “wraps around” and jumps to the opposite edge. For example if Frieda begins in the center square and makes two hops “up”, the first hop would place her in the top row middle square, and the second hop would cause Frieda to jump to the opposite edge, landing in the bottom row middle square.

Suppose Frieda starts from the center square, makes at most four hops at random, and stops hopping if she lands on a corner square. What is the probability that she reaches a corner square on one of the four hops?
Solution:
Group the squares into three types: \(M\) for the center, \(E\) for an edge-middle square, and \(C\) for a corner. From \(M\), every hop goes to \(E\). From any \(E\), two directions reach \(C\), one returns to \(M\), and one wraps to another \(E\). Their probabilities are therefore \(1/2,1/4,1/4\), respectively.

The first hop always reaches \(E\), so a corner can first be reached on hop \(2\), \(3\), or \(4\). The table lists the types reached after each hop; the starting \(M\) is omitted.
\[
\begin{array}{c|l}
\text{route}&\text{probability}\\\hline
EC&1\cdot\tfrac12=\tfrac12\\
EEC&1\cdot\tfrac14\cdot\tfrac12=\tfrac18\\
EEEC&1\cdot(\tfrac14)^2\cdot\tfrac12=\tfrac1{32}\\
EMEC&1\cdot\tfrac14\cdot1\cdot\tfrac12=\tfrac18
\end{array}
\]

These are all the first-arrival routes: just before reaching \(C\), the frog must be at \(E\). For a first arrival on hop \(3\), this forces \(EE\) before the final hop. For one on hop \(4\), the first three types must be \(EEE\) or \(EME\), because a visit to \(M\) must be followed by \(E\). The routes are disjoint, since each records the first corner visit and the frog stops there.

Adding gives
\[
\frac12+\frac18+\frac1{32}+\frac18
=\boxed{\frac{25}{32}},
\]
choice D. Counting first arrivals keeps an early corner visit from being counted again on a later hop.
